text:
QuarkForge is a fast-moving fintech startup building real-time payment orchestration for emerging markets. We’re a small, mission-driven team shipping high-throughput backend services that handle millions of transactions a day. Join us to build resilient systems that scale and to take ownership from prototype to production.

What you'll do
- Design and implement backend services and APIs that power payment routing, reconciliation, and audit trails.
- Build production-grade, highly available systems on AWS; own deployment, monitoring and incident response.
- Collaborate with product and frontend to define clear contracts and iterate quickly on features.
- Optimize performance and cost for high-volume workloads; write robust tests and CI/CD pipelines.
- Mentor peers, run design reviews and contribute to architecture decisions.

What we need (mandatory)
- 4-7 years experience
- Node.js
- AWS

Bonus points (preferred/good-to-have)
- Express.js
- MongoDB
- Docker
- TypeScript

Location and work mode
Pune, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
